media.prompt: Frame Interpolation: FILM or RIFE: sample from ComfyUI's template library
media.note: From ComfyUI's template library (MIT). Not rendered on this machine yet.

what: Makes in-between frames, so a clip plays smoother.
dossier:
1.  If Input is Video:
       Use Video Super-Resolution models (FlashVSR, SeedVR2) [MODEL.md].
2.  If Input is Latent (Diffusion Space):
       Use Latent Upscalers (SD 2x Latent Upscaler) [MODEL.md].
3.  If Input is Image:
       If Goal is Resolution Increase: Use Super-resolution GANs (ESRGAN, Real-ESRGAN, RGT, HAT, Thera, AuraSR, etc.) [MODEL.md].
       If Goal is Noise Reduction/Restoration: Use Image Restoration models (NAFNet) [MODEL.md].
       If Goal is Color/Contrast Adjustment: Use Color Rescaling models (CRM, IRN) [MODEL.md].
       If Goal is PBR Material Upscaling: Use PBRFusion4 [MODEL.md].
